news_items.headline: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet on his company's monopoly: no one is coming for us
news_items.summary: CEO Fouquet at Milken Institute Global Conference framed ASML's competitive moat as durable; emphasized accelerating AI-driven chip demand. ASML now Europe's most valuable company at >$530B.

news_items.headline: ASML stock surges 6.87% on rising AI demand outlook
news_items.summary: Shares outperformed tech sector (2.36%) as hyperscaler capex (MSFT/META/AMZN/GOOGL >$600B in 2026) reinforced multi-year demand for ASML lithography tools.

news_items.headline: TSMC will not buy ASML High-NA EUV machines for A13 node
news_items.summary: TSMC Co-COO Kevin Zhang said the A13 process does not require High-NA EUV. Removes a key reference customer adoption catalyst for ASML's most advanced tool.

news_items.headline: ASML provides regular update on share buyback program execution
news_items.summary: ASML repurchased shares on four consecutive trading days, daily volume ~12,895-13,383 shares at ~EUR 15.87M/day. Ongoing capital return signal.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Consensus remains Buy across 8-42 analyst surveys (79% buy weighting in broader set). No specific upgrade/downgrade headlines surfaced in last 7 days.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 (reported April) beat with EUR 8.8B net sales and 53% gross margin; FY2026 guidance raised to EUR 36-40B on AI/memory/logic demand. Risks: slow immersion sales start, Q2 margin compression, 2027 unit targets conditional, export control uncertainty.
